intro.text: The head ardent of the Alethi warcamps on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Chanada moved to Urithiru through the Oathgate with the rest of the warcamps. Hearing that Dalinar and Navani were courting, she had Kadash tell the other ardents not to marry them, so no ardent would, and the Stormfather married them instead.
